meta.source: openICPSR 100707 - UCR Offenses Known and Clearances by Arrest (Return A), 1960-2024
meta.caveat: County figures are summed from agency reports. Overlapping jurisdictions, agencies straddling county lines, and non-reporting agencies all distort them; see https://ucrbook.com/county-level-data.html. Agency-years without all twelve months reported are excluded, and the share of each county's population that did report is carried as cov. Agencies with no single county - state police, multi-county districts - are excluded entirely. Aggravated assault is the aggravated column only; simple assault is not included.
